title: Woman Kills Husband in Golf Cart Crash After Drinking Vodka
description:
Bodycam footage shows Port St. Lucie police responding to a golf course after 59-year-old Daniel Mackin fell from a golf cart driven by his wife, 62-year-old Cynthia Macki. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
